articles.headline: Tata Communications Invests $450 Million in AI Infrastructure
articles.brief: Tata Communications is committing $450 million to develop advanced AI connectivity infrastructure and data centers, creating a high-speed digital superhighway to meet surging enterprise demand.

articles.headline: Meta's Muse AI Applauded by Bill Gates
articles.brief: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has praised Meta's Muse personal AI agent as the first major consumer-ready product of its kind, while cautioning against open-weight models lacking safeguards.

articles.headline: Ather Energy Posts First Profitable Quarter
articles.brief: Electric vehicle manufacturer Ather Energy has reported its first-ever quarterly profit, driving a 10% surge in its share price as consumer adoption of EVs continues to accelerate nationwide.

articles.headline: Gold Prices Rise Amid Falling Oil Costs
articles.brief: Gold prices gained traction as a recent slide in global oil prices helped cool broader inflation concerns across international markets, prompting increased safe-haven investments.

articles.headline: Indian Publishers Challenge Modi's Privacy Law
articles.brief: High-profile media outlets, including enterprises associated with billionaire industrialists Ambani and Adani, have joined other Indian publishers in challenging controversial provisions of Modi’s privacy legislation.

articles.headline: Congress and BJP Plan Major Rival Rallies
articles.brief: Political tensions are escalating as the Congress party prepares for a massive 'Vote Bachao' protest rally in New Delhi, while BJP leader Amit Shah is set to spearhead a counter-march in Telangana.

articles.headline: Government Approves Massive Defense Acquisition Deal
articles.brief: The Defence Acquisition Council has cleared a massive Rs 2.12 lakh crore procurement package aimed at significantly upgrading the operational capabilities of the Indian armed forces.

articles.headline: Government Permits Pure Ethanol Flex-Fuel Vehicles
articles.brief: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has amended motor vehicle rules to officially permit pure ethanol flex-fuel vehicles, updating fuel specifications and emissions standards accordingly.

articles.headline: Aiden Markram Outlines South Africa's WTC Ambitions
articles.brief: South African captain Aiden Markram expressed strong confidence in his team's ability to reach the ICC World Test Championship final ahead of their decisive upcoming clash against Australia.

articles.headline: Ballon d'Or Race Heats Up Among Top Contenders
articles.brief: Lionel Messi remains in contention for football's highest individual honor alongside rising stars like Yamal and Mbappe, as the sports world anticipates the annual award announcement.

articles.headline: Ebola Experts to Investigate Nigeria Case Origin
articles.brief: Africa CDC officials and international scientists are launching an investigation into the origin of a recent Ebola case detected in Nigeria to prevent potential regional transmission.

articles.headline: Lula da Silva Wins Record Fourth Brazilian Term
articles.brief: In a major political comeback, Lula da Silva secured a historic fourth presidential term in Brazil, defeating far-right opposition and defying regional political trends.

articles.headline: Trump Issues Warning to Iran Amid Tensions
articles.brief: Former US President Donald Trump warned Iran that it is 'decision time' regarding regional maritime routes, threatening renewed military strikes if a formal agreement is not reached.

articles.headline: Thousands Evacuated as Cyclone Arnab Nears Coast
articles.brief: Authorities in India have initiated mass evacuations across eastern coastal regions as Cyclone Arnab rapidly intensifies into a severe storm, threatening landfall in Andhra Pradesh.

articles.headline: Storm Boelo Disrupts Transport Across the UK
articles.brief: Storm Boelo has brought gale-force winds and heavy rainfall to Scotland and northern England, causing widespread travel disruptions, power outages, and localized flood warnings.
